source: PPL9 skeleton-spawner collection mechanism extracted in test-worlds/ppl9-mobs
adaptations: Every plot is an independent copy of the extracted collection mechanism, with its own external double-chest output.
The source's unaudited ender chest and comparator tiles are removed from each disposable copy.

The three mechanisms occupy distinct chunks, 17 blocks apart so their profiling protection belts (mechanism expanded by 2) do not overlap and all three can be profiled at once; a shared AFK pad outside every belt is within the vanilla 16-block player activation range of all three spawners.

Each spawner is configured for zombified piglins at 5..10 ticks, spawn count 128 and max nearby 1024. This is an intentionally high-load schedule (about four times the prior high-load schedule); its spawner-created piglins stay non-persistent as vanilla spawns them (stasis captures them natively), while a persistent invulnerable iron golem performs native kills and the original hopper route collects the gold-nugget output without an input resource.
